name: OpenAI API key
remediation: Revoke the key in OpenAI, issue a replacement, and remove it from Git history.

name: GitHub token
remediation: Revoke the token in GitHub, issue a scoped replacement, and remove it from Git history.

name: AWS access key ID
remediation: Deactivate the access key in AWS IAM, investigate usage, and rotate related credentials.

name: Stripe secret key
remediation: Roll the key in Stripe and remove it from the repository history.

name: Private key header
remediation: Rotate the corresponding key pair and remove the private key from Git history.
